fixes.what: Remove `border-radius:12px 12px 0 0` (or set to `2px 2px 0 0`) on `.hww-panel` at mobile widths
fixes.why: A 12px rounded sheet top feels like a generic iOS app modal rather than the crisp editorial geometry of the rest of the brand book.

fixes.what: Adjust `.nav-home` width formula at `@media (max-width:768px)` from `min(120px,calc(100vw - 230px))` to `min(120px,calc(100vw - 210px))`
fixes.why: Gives the intricate Persian kashida line inside the centered header wordmark slightly more breathing room on 360px–375px screens without touching the controls.
